mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly rise in GDPC1 signals expanding economic activity, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05 in t-test) despite a sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1, or the trend reverses in subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%, or the trigger does not occur as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE signals Fed balancing tightening with improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% AND UNRATE falls >0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: Returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) when the interaction occurs, or the trigger conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% triggers inflation concerns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.5% in the tightening regime, or the trigger does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in HOUST signals strong consumer demand, leading to short-term positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) despite a monthly increase in HOUST, or the trend reverses.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 100 indicates weakening business activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next quarter (60 days).
failure_condition: Returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 100, or the trigger does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 suggests Fed tightening paired with robust demand growth, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.3% AND GDPC1 rises >5% in the same month
failure_condition: Returns do not rise significantly (p > 0.05) when both proxies move as predicted, or the trigger conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in UNRATE below 3.5% signals labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns remain positive despite UNRATE falling below 3.5% in the late-cycle regime, or the trigger does not occur.
